committee: * CERTIFICATE PRESENTATION 282-38(COR) - Office of Senator Shelly Calvo
title: Buenas yan Håfa Adai! Please join us for the presentation for the following certificate. Certificate No. 282-38 (COR) - Shelly V. Calvo - “for your contributions to strengthen Guam’s artistic identity and your service in advancing the Arts; and to commend you for your commitment to the preservation and promotion of CHamoru culture.” The certificate will be presented to Dr. Judith “Judy” Selk Flores The presentation will take place on Sunday, January 11, 2025 Friday, January 16, 2026 at 12:00 P.M at the Kracked Egg, Tumon We look forward to your attendance and participation. Si Yu’os Ma’åse’!…
